user.title: DTEK Outages
user.description: Connect your Telegram account to receive DTEK outage updates. You will log in by scanning a QR code with Telegram on another device.

data_description.channel: Comma-separated Telegram usernames or numeric channel IDs.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Telegram
reauth_confirm.description: Review your Telegram credentials, then scan a new QR code to sign in again.

qr.title: Scan the QR code with Telegram
qr.description: On a device where Telegram is signed in, open **Settings → Devices → Link Desktop Device** and scan the code below within 30 seconds, then select **Submit**.

2fa.title: Telegram two-step verification
2fa.description: Enter the password configured for Telegram two-step verification.

error.invalid_api: Telegram rejected the API ID or API hash.
error.qr_not_scanned: The QR code has not been scanned yet. Scan it, then select Submit.
error.qr_expired: The QR code expired. Scan the new code, then select Submit.
error.invalid_password: This two-step verification password is incorrect.

abort.reauth_entry_missing: The existing DTEK Outages entry could not be found.
abort.qr_login_failed: Telegram QR login failed. Check the Home Assistant log, then try again.
abort.2fa_failed: Telegram two-step verification failed. Start authentication again.
